author: Protel
body:
Hello! Theoretical here,

I'm going to be doing a little giveaway for the users on Avicus as a little give-back to the community, if it does well, I will consider doing them bi-monthly or even monthly :).  

The giveaway includes:
- 3-Month Gold Rank
- 5 Beta Keys
- 5 Alpha Keys

Here's the link to enter: https://gleam.io/teo9s/january-giveaway

**If you are a donator already, message me and we can find something of equal value for the rank ($15) or to a friend!

Best of luck, the contest will be ending on Wednesday, January 27th!

Leave a comment below if there is any questions or any trouble entering the giveaway.
